title: Alcar

conquest.title: Glorious Mark
conquest.description: A Praetorian's glory is his strength. Alcar enters an invulnerable state (unable to move or cast skills, immune to control effects) and reduces Damage Taken by 30%/40%/50%/60%/70% for nearby friendly squads for 2s.

conquest.title: Boneshatter
conquest.description: Alcar spears a line of enemies, dealing Attack*70%/77%/84%/91%/98% damage and increases the Damage Taken for enemies hit by 20% for 2s.

conquest.title: Second Wind
conquest.description: Alcar's loyalty to the old ways give him strength. " Glorious Mark" restores Attack*30%/33%/36%/39%/42% Health every second for 5s.

expedition.title: Rescuing Hands
expedition.description: Alcar's utter dedication to keeping his men safe is well-proved. Reduces Infantry and Archer's Damage Taken by 14%/28%/42%/56%/70% every 5 turns for 2 turns.

expedition.title: Praetorian Will
expedition.description: The fighting belligerence of a Praetorian is something for others to study. Increases Infantry Damage Dealt by 20%/40%/60%/80%/100% and C Avalry and Archer's Damage Dealt by 2%/4%/6%/8%/10%.

expedition.title: Carpe Diem
expedition.description: Years of training have taught Alcar how to exploit enemy weakness, increasing Infantry Damage Dealt per attack by 12%/24%/36%/48%/60% and target Damage Taken by 5%/10%/15%/20%/25% for 1 turn.

skills.title: Flagbearer
skills.description: Glory is best shared. Glory Mark increases friendly Squads' Attack by 30%/33%/36%/39%/42% for 2.5s.

skills.title: Vow of Honor
skills.description: There is power in the steadfast vow. Alcar increases Defender Squads' Health by 5%/7.5%/10%/12.5%/15%.

story: Alcar was once a member of the Praetorian Guard. More precisely, he held the prestigious title of " Flagbearer," a rank reserved for the cream of the crop.

Ordinary citizens might not fully grasp the significance of this title, which signifies absolute strength and unwavering loyalty. It is an exceptional honor earned through fierce competition among the legions. Among all the Praetorian Guards, there can be only one Flagbearer.
"Surrender is never an option! We do not retreat, we do not yield! Raise your weapons! This is loyalty to the Emperor, this is a Vow of Honor!" Alcar once declared.
"We're an impregnable force, standing steadfast at the frontlines."
"We shall protect the Emperor, even at the cost of our lives!"

Time and again, Alcar revisited the moment he was appointed Flagbearer in his dreams, only to be pulled back to reality by the biting cold of the wintry night. At the sound of hurried footsteps, he instinctively tightened his grip on his weapon...
"They only send us because they think there's no chance of winning! You need to know that, Alcar!"
"Exactly! I'm sure the empire's already a lost cause!"
"I don't believe it... His Majesty wouldn't just stand by and watch this happen..."
"For heaven's sake, where's the Emperor now?! The empire's a gone case, and the power's fallen into other hands."
"We have to win this impossible battle to have a chance to see His Majesty."
"I'm b Egging you, Alcar. I know this is tough, but that's the reason we're sent here..."

Alcar couldn't remember who convinced him to fight back then. The Empire's fate seemed to have nothing to do with the Praetorian Guards, who lived by loyalty, but at that moment, none of it mattered anymore...

Alcar endures the agony of surviving while his comrades fell and the torment of betraying his own beliefs. When he removes his armor, it reveals a body marked by scars—not only from the battles he survived but also from the pain he inflicted upon himself in his search for redemption.

Now, this former Flagbearer has been given a new lease on life in this small town. His past fame no longer binds him. "I've long given up on changing the world. Now, I only strive to stay true to myself,' he said.
